scenes.name: Bistro
scenes.subtitle: Café terrace
scenes.description: A sunlit café terrace with detailed stonework, foliage and warm practical lighting. Rendered with SGL3D.
scenes.comparisonDescription: Matched captures from the same camera. Only the selected feature changes; all other settings stay the same.
scenes.credits: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro by Amazon, CC BY 4.0. Prepared glTF conversion with corrected materials and authored lighting. San Giuseppe Bridge environment by Greg Zaal / Poly Haven, CC0.

features.name: Ambient occlusion
features.description: Adds soft contact shadows where surfaces meet, grounding objects in the scene.

features.name: Diffuse GI
features.description: Bounces diffuse light between surfaces, bringing light and colour into shaded areas.

features.name: Bloom
features.description: Spreads bright highlights into a soft glow around lights and reflective surfaces.

features.name: Temporal anti-aliasing
features.description: Combines successive frames to smooth jagged edges and reduce shimmering in fine detail.
